tooltip: A typed constructor field for a locally-declared enum's constants - place inside the enum's "fields" section. Each one becomes a "final <type> <name>;" member plus a matching constructor parameter; the enum's constant list (below) gets one value input per field. Double-click the type to pick from every variable type registered by an installed plugin (MCreator's own native searchable selector), resolved to its real Java class for the active generator - pick-only, no free typing (so no separate int/long/float, just "double" for numbers - use the "field (custom type)" block instead for those or any other exact Java type). Not connectable anywhere outside an enum's fields section.
